limitations: Current physical motion and observation updates in these runs are still synchronous. Their simulation timestep does not establish real-time wall-clock execution.
The separately requested asynchronous observation/inference/continuous-IK architecture is outside this source snapshot and needs a fresh audit.
These trajectories and covariance-region counts do not establish statistical calibration or resolve absolute-pose overconfidence.

The 15-tick lazy/dense comparison isolates K proposal equivalence. Total live Hz also depends on observed-marker availability and executed behavior, so whole-run speedups are not inferred from proposal timings.
Search amplitude is a sent-joint-command bound, not a Cartesian error/radius guarantee. Physical tip displacement is validation-only.
Actual received point distributions, metadata, stiffness and scene wire are checked. Camera Image-topic pixels were not independently audited.
Runtime code and core laws were frozen during these original runs; this statement does not assert that subsequent asynchronous working-tree code has been verified.
